system.specialAbility:
You become Trained in Guile and Thievery, and you become Trained in a relevant Lore of your choice.

Example Lores include Prison Lore, Penal Law Lore, Lore of a particular prison.
system.description: You spent part of your life behind locked doors, whether the sentence was just or otherwise. You learned to hide what mattered, bargain with limited means, and make patient use of small opportunities.
